20478-strong-souls-a-sermon.title: Sunday, October 29, 1882.
20478-strong-souls-a-sermon.creator: Unknown
20478-strong-souls-a-sermon.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. f its intellectual points of contact with humanity, by the width of its sympathies, the largeness of its hopes. Still more, there is a quality of intensity in which lives differ: some live more in a week than others in a year: it is not that they are consuming themselves under stress of circumstance or in agony of passion, but that their fibre is stronger, their central flame brighter, their power of endurance larger.

48695-the-stag-cook-book-written-for-men.title: The Stag Cook Book Written For Men By Men
48695-the-stag-cook-book-written-for-men.creator: Robert H. Davis
48695-the-stag-cook-book-written-for-men.description: A book by Robert H. Davis. Charles Lamb’s essay on roast pig was responsible for a tidal wave of burnt pork that swept over England in the nineteenth century. Lamb led a hungry empire to the belief that only through an act of incendiarism could a suckling porker be converted into a delicacy; whereas, as a matter of fact, the perfection of roast pork, golden-brown and unseared by fire, were possible only in the oven.

arxiv-1611-01263.title: A family of braneworld wormholes
arxiv-1611-01263.creator: Gabino Estevez Delgado, Joaquin Estevez Delgado, Refugio Rigel Mora-Luna
arxiv-1611-01263.description: Abstract A wormhole solution is presented on a braneworld scenery, the material source is given by a perfect fluid on brane that does not violate the energy conditions. we propose an ansatz for the state equation resulting in a family of solutions that satisfy necessary conditions over the free parameters of the solution.

arxiv-2005-01861.title: Sampling Arbitrary Subgraphs Exactly Uniformly in Sublinear Time
arxiv-2005-01861.creator: Hendrik Fichtenberger, Mingze Gao, Pan Peng
arxiv-2005-01861.description: Abstract We present a simple sublinear-time algorithm for sampling an arbitrary subgraph H H exactly uniformly from a graph G G with m m edges, to which the algorithm has access by performing the following types of queries: (1) degree queries, (2) neighbor queries, (3) pair queries and (4) edge sampling queries.

arxiv-2202-06542.title: Tensionless Strings and Killing(-Yano) Tensors
arxiv-2202-06542.creator: Ulf Lindström
arxiv-2202-06542.description: Abstract UUITP-06/22 a Department of Physics, Faculty of Arts and Sciences, Middle East Technical University, 06800, Ankara, Turkey b Department of Physics and Astronomy, Theoretical Physics, Uppsala University SE-751 20 Uppsala, Sweden Abstract We construct invariants for bosonic and spinning tensionless (null) strings in backgrounds that carry Killing tensors or Killing-Yano tensors of mixed type.

arxiv-2403-16940.title: Dynamics of Affective Polarization: From Consensus to Partisan Divides
arxiv-2403-16940.creator: Buddhika Nettasinghe, Allon G. Percus, Kristina Lerman, University of Iowa, Claremont Graduate University, USC Information Sciences Institute, To whom correspondence should be addressed; E-mail: buddhika-nettasinghe@uiowa.edu
arxiv-2403-16940.description: Abstract Politically divided societies are also often divided emotionally: people like and trust those with similar political views (in-group favoritism) while disliking and distrusting those with different views (out-group animosity). This phenomenon, called affective polarization, influences individual decisions, including seemingly apolitical choices such as whether to wear a mask or what car to buy.

arxiv-2409-13361.title: RapidOMS: FPGA-based Open Modification Spectral Library Searching with HD Computing
arxiv-2409-13361.creator: Sumukh Pinge 1, Weihong Xu 1, Wout Bittremieux 2, Niema Moshiri 1, Sang-Woo Jun 3, Tajana Rosing 1
arxiv-2409-13361.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sumukh Pinge 1, Weihong Xu 1, Wout Bittremieux 2, Niema Moshiri 1, Sang-Woo Jun 3, Tajana Rosing 1. Mass spectrometry (MS) is essential for protein analysis but faces significant challenges with large datasets and complex post-translational modifications, resulting in difficulties in spectral identification. Open Modification Search (OMS) improves the analysis of these modifications. We present RapidOMS, a solution leveraging the Samsung SmartSSD, which integrates SSD and FPGA in a near-storage configuration to minimize data movement and enhance the efficiency of large-scale database searching.

arxiv-2502-19318.title: Does 3D Gaussian Splatting Need Accurate Volumetric Rendering?
arxiv-2502-19318.creator: A. Celarek 1 , G. Kopanas 2,3,4 , G. Drettakis 3,4 , M. Wimmer 1 and B. Kerbl 1 1 TU Wien, Austria, 2 Google, United Kingdom, 3 Inria, France, 4 Université Côte d’Azur, France
arxiv-2502-19318.description: Abstract Since its introduction, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become an important reference method for learning 3D representations of a captured scene, allowing real-time novel-view synthesis with high visual quality and fast training times. Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs), which preceded 3DGS, are based on a principled ray-marching approach for volumetric rendering.

pmc-10702051.title: An in vitro study measuring marginal gaps of inlay restorations fabricated from different CAD-CAM materials after thermocycling
pmc-10702051.creator: Ahmed Ismail Taha, Mona Elshirbini Hafez
pmc-10702051.description: BackgroundMany monolithic machined materials have been introduced and provided a suitable mechanical and physical properties for inlay restorations. However, there is shortage in the studies evaluating the marginal adaptation using these materials.PurposeThis study aimed to compare the effect of fabricating inlay restorations from 3 different CAD-CAM materials on marginal gaps before and after thermocycling.

pmc-10839063.title: Unraveling the impact of nitric oxide, almitrine, and their combination in COVID-19 (at the edge of sepsis) patients: a systematic review
pmc-10839063.creator: Ying Wang, Qian Yu, Yuan Tian, Shiying Ren, Liping Liu, Chaojie Wei, Renli Liu, Jing Wang, Dong Li, Kun Zhu
pmc-10839063.description: Introduction: During the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, a large number of critically ill and severe COVID-19 patients meet the diagnostic criteria for sepsis and even septic shock. The treatments for COVID-19 patients with sepsis are still very limited. For sepsis, improving ventilation is one of the main treatments.

pmc-11329512.title: MksB is a novel mycobacterial condensin that orchestrates spatiotemporal positioning of replication machinery
pmc-11329512.creator: Hanna Bułacz, Joanna Hołówka, Wiktoria Wójcik, Jolanta Zakrzewska-Czerwińska
pmc-11329512.description: Condensins play important roles in maintaining bacterial chromatin integrity. In mycobacteria, three types of condensins have been characterized: a homolog of SMC and two MksB-like proteins, the recently identified MksB and EptC. Previous studies suggest that EptC contributes to defending against foreign DNA, while SMC and MksB may play roles in chromosome organization.

pmc-11432539.title: Ascochlorin Attenuates the Early Stage of Adipogenesis via the Wnt/β-Catenin Pathway and Inhibits High-Fat-Diet-Induced Obesity in Mice
pmc-11432539.creator: Mi-Hee Yu, Yun-Jeong Jeong, Sung Wook Son, So Yoon Kwon, Kwon-Ho Song, Ho-Sang Son, Eon-Ju Jeon, Young-Chae Chang, Grażyna Nowicka
pmc-11432539.description: This study investigated the effects of ascochlorin (ASC), a natural compound derived from the fungus Ascochyta viciae, on adipogenesis and obesity. We determined the effects of ASC on 3T3-L1 preadipocytes and whether it ameliorated to mitigate high-fat diet (HFD)-induced obesity in C57BL/6J mice.

pmc-11508986.title: Erythropoiesis and Gene Expression Analysis in Erythroid Progenitor Cells Derived from Patients with Hemoglobin H/Constant Spring Disease
pmc-11508986.creator: Narawich Wongkhammul, Pinyaphat Khamphikham, Siripong Tongjai, Adisak Tantiworawit, Kanda Fanhchaksai, Somsakul Pop Wongpalee, Alisa Tubsuwan, Supawadee Maneekesorn, Pimlak Charoenkwan, Shira Rockowitz, Piotr Sliz
pmc-11508986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hemoglobin H/Constant Spring (Hb H/CS) disease represents a form of non-deletional Hb H disease characterized by chronic hemolytic anemia that ranges from moderate to severe and may lead to transfusion-dependent thalassemia. To study the underlying mechanisms of this disease, we conducted an analysis of erythropoiesis and gene expression in erythroid progenitor cells derived from CD34+ hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells from patients with Hb H/CS disease and normal controls. Twelve patients with Hb H/CS disease and five normal controls were enrolled.

pmc-11665740.title: A Rare Case of Triple-Positive Breast Cancer With Eventual Triple-Negative Small Bowel Metastasis
pmc-11665740.creator: Micah Ngatuvai, Anthony Pasarin, Abanoub Gabra, Ihor Pidhorecky
pmc-11665740.description: Invasive lobular breast cancer (ILBC) is a common cause of breast cancer. Prognosis is dependent on many factors such as metastasis location and hormone receptor positivity. A 59-year-old postmenopausal African-American female who was referred to our clinic in May of 2022 presented with a suspicious small bowel lesion seen on surveillance imaging.

pmc-12471362.title: Prognostic Significance of Peritumoral and Intratumoral Lymphatic Vessels Density in Clinically Node-Negative (cN0) Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma: A Preliminary Report
pmc-12471362.creator: Boris Kos, Petar Suton, Danko Müller, Vid Mirošević, Matija Mamić, Ivica Lukšić
pmc-12471362.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is characterized by a high propensity for cervical lymph node metastasis, which remains a strong predictor of patient outcome. Despite advances in management, the prognosis for OSCC has not significantly improved, and the identification of reliable predictors for occult lymph node metastasis (OLNM) in clinically node-negative (cN0) patients is crucial for optimizing treatment strategies.

pmc-12521193.title: Endothelial Zmiz1 modulates developmental angiogenesis in the retina
pmc-12521193.creator: Nehal R. Patel, Shreya A. Bavishi, Adella P. Bartoletti, Rajan K C, Avery Blanks, Kelsey Carter, Mark Y. Chiang, Stryder M. Meadows
pmc-12521193.description: Angiogenesis is a highly coordinated process involving the control of various endothelial cell behaviors. Mechanisms for transcription factor involvement in the regulation of endothelial cell dynamics and angiogenesis have become better understood, however much remains unknown, especially the role of non-DNA binding transcriptional cofactors.

pmc-12610783.description: one-way valves in patients with severe COPD, bronchial thermoplasty for the treatment of severe asthma, and navigational bronchoscopy. In recent times, the field of interventional pulmonology has grown significantly, along with the increasing need for an anesthesiologist for each of these procedures.

pmc-12712203.title: The effect of storage temperature and time before centrifugation on coagulation parameters in neonatal Japanese Black calves
pmc-12712203.creator: Riko ITO, Keinosuke SANADA, Satoshi INOUE, Toko MAEHARA, Hiroshi SATOH
pmc-12712203.description: This study aimed to determine the effects of precentrifugation storage time and temperature on coagulation and fibrinolysis parameters in Japanese Black calves. Blood samples were collected from calves under 6 weeks of age into plastic tubes containing 3.2% sodium citrate. Whole blood was stored at either room temperature or under refrigeration prior to centrifugation.

pmc-13025681.title: Quasi-Maximum Exponential Likelihood Estimation of Conditional Quantiles for GARCH Models Based on High-Frequency Augmented Data
pmc-13025681.creator: Zhenming Zhang, Shishun Zhao, Jianhua Cheng, Anze Wang
pmc-13025681.description: GARCH models play a fundamental role in modeling time-varying volatility in financial return series. In practice, financial returns are also well known to exhibit heavy-tailed distributions, which naturally motivates the use of quasi-maximum exponential likelihood estimation (QMELE) for accurately capturing tail behavior and risk measures such as Value-at-Risk.

pmc-13234937.title: Mapping the landscape of state Medicaid policy
pmc-13234937.creator: Grace Beals, Marissa Rivera, Jamila Michener
pmc-13234937.description: BackgroundFederal changes in Medicaid policy are the subject of significant national attention and debate. In contrast, state-level Medicaid policies are more of a black box: difficult to keep track of and much less salient. These disparate attention and information contexts obscure the important ways that federal and state Medicaid policies compare.

pmc-13239703.title: Community-based social connection intervention programme to improve cardiovascular and brain health in older adults in rural Ecuador: study protocol for a quasi-experimental trial
pmc-13239703.creator: Victor J Del Brutto, Giselle Leal, Robertino M Mera, Denisse A Rumbea, Maria Jose Abad, Oscar H Del Brutto
pmc-13239703.description: IntroductionLoneliness and social isolation are increasingly recognised as determinants of cardiovascular and brain health, particularly among older adults. Evidence from high-income settings links social disconnection to higher risk of coronary heart disease, stroke, cognitive decline and mortality, yet few interventions have been adapted for rural, resource-limited environments.

pmc-13330660.title: The Effect of Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists on Pain Management in Chronic Pancreatitis: A Real-World Cohort Study
pmc-13330660.creator: Arkadeep Dhali, Rick Maity, Fayaz Khan, Abdul Rafae Faisal, Jyotirmoy Biswas, Adnan Bhat, Sushobhon Ghosh
pmc-13330660.description: Background and AimsChronic pancreatitis (CP) is a debilitating inflammatory condition characterized by irreversible glandular destruction and intractable pain. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) have demonstrated anti-inflammatory properties in preclinical models, yet their impact on clinical outcomes in CP remains unexplored.MethodsIn this retrospective cohort study, adult patients (≥18 years) with CP were identified from the TriNetX US Collaborative Network.
